note.zh-TW: 老師的模板沒有這一列，網站內部保留，機器設備的位置顯示淨額。
note.en: The teacher's template has no such line; the site keeps it internally and shows machinery and equipment net.

definition.zh-TW: 設備從買進到現在已經提列的折舊總額。它是機器設備的抵銷科目，成本減掉它就是帳面淨額。
definition.en: The total depreciation charged on the equipment since it was bought. It offsets machinery and equipment: cost less this balance is the carrying amount.
